messages:
Aisha (CS): Live update — Zephyr edge rollout started at 09:12. Putting together a tiny customer-facing 'ramp play' note: warmpool sizing, jitter, short fallbacks, how we capture churn signals. Draft below.

Marco (Solutions): nice. Keep it 1-pager + a 2-line pasteable prefill + exact thresholds customers can monitor.

Priya (Onboarding): Add a 24h micro-checklist for the CSM and a heads-up script for the customer call. Also include which console graphs to look at.

Aisha (CS): DRAFT — Zephyr micro-ramp play (customer facing)
- Goal: avoid sudden token storm, keep chat p95 < 1.8s during first 72h, flag renewal risks early.
- Minimum actions (first 60m):
  • Warmpool baseline: warm_pool=40 (tenant-wide); add 10% every 15m until target.
  • Client backoff: advise exponential backoff with 0.5–2s base and random jitter ±15%.
  • Cache rules: prompt prefix cache 6h, ephemeral session KV 36h; lower TTLs if user churn >25%/hr.
- Prefill policy (UI chat): prefill_per_user=4 in first 30m, then 1 per hour for next 24h. For press/demo, prefill 20m prior at 50% estimated concurrency.
- Batching & streaming: use batch_size ≤5 for interactive flows (max_wait_ms=25). For bulk exports, batch_size up to 128 with batch_window_ms=300. Streaming chunk 320 bytes for web clients; mobile: stream=false for first 24h if unstable.
- UX fallback: cached short card (one sentence + link to retry) instead of error modal. Keep payload <900 bytes.
- Signals to log: p50/p95/p99, cache_hit_ratio, warmpool_util, 429/sec, repeated_user_errors (distinct user count).
- Renewal heuristics (CS flag): sustained 10% drop in successful completions over 3h + >2x rise in 4xx/5xx.
- Escalation steps:
  1) CSM triage (0–15m): confirm console shows warm_pool utilization, cache_hit_ratio, prefills ran. Message customer PM.
  2) CSM mitigation (15–45m): reduce batch_size, enable prefix-only cache, set prefill_marker=paused.
  3) Eng oncall (45m+): open ticket when p95 >2s AND 5xx_rate >3% after CSM mitigations. Include route, last_3h p95, cache_hit_ratio, prefills timestamps.
- 24h / 72h quick checks:
  • 24h: cache_hit_ratio ≥55% OR escalate. Confirm no repeating errors across >3 users.
  • 72h: traffic plateaued, token burn per MAU within expected range, customer satisfaction quick poll done.

Marco (Solutions): Pasteable prefill (for their CI hooks):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"tenant":"zephyr","route":"chat:web","count":4,"window_s":1800,"note":"go-live-micro"}'
```

Priya (Onboarding): I'll add the 24h call script: two bullets — confirm latency + ask for any recurring weirdness. I'll join the 24h check.

Theo (Zephyr): Perfect. One ask: what should the UI show if warm_pool depletes? Prefer silent fallback. 

Aisha (CS): Silent fallback = cached short card + enqueue background prefill with exponential backoff capped at 3 retries. Will put that in the PDF.

eng-bot: ENG checklist: include route name, warm_pool size, last_3h p95, cache_hit_ratio, prefills timestamps when filing ticket.

Aisha (CS): I'll export this as a two-column PDF and share with Zephyr PM. Thanks all.

Theo (Zephyr): Thanks team. Appreciated. :pray:
